topic: Enabling and creating a multi-organization (parent/child) setup
symptom_pattern: Customer wants a parent organization with child organizations to separate environments or business units under centralized management. A self-service assistant told them the multi-org feature needed internal enablement and sent them to live chat.
root_cause: No fault. The customer's account could already create child organizations. When the support engineer had them open the new organization page, the customer confirmed it allowed them to create a new child organization, so no support-side enablement was needed.
resolution_path: The support engineer asked the customer to open the new organization page in the Datadog app and report whether it let them create a new child organization.
The customer confirmed that it did.
The support engineer told the customer to use that page to set up the new child organization.
info_needed: Whether the account's new organization page allows creating a child organization

qa_pairs.tse_question: Could you open the new organization page and tell me whether it lets you create a new child organization?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, the page allows creating a child organization.

evidence: Account settings, such as allow-listed IP addresses, are not inherited by child-organizations
SAML setup is not inherited — it must be configured for each child-organization individually

steps: Greeted the customer and asked how they could help.
Took a moment to review the request.
Asked the customer to open the new organization page and say whether it let them create a child organization.
Confirmed with the customer that it did, then directed them to use that page to set up the child org.
key_questions: Could you navigate to the new organization page and let me know if it enables you to create a new child organization?
